decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation is an uncertain but low-cost option that builds on existing capabilities, so its option value justifies keeping it on the market.
As a low-cost digital tool in the core weir dimensioning domain, its prospects remain uncertain and carrying costs are minimal, making the option worth keeping.
The fouling detection system may carry higher costs than pure automation but still leverages established offer and unresolved potential, so it is kept with moderate caution.
